optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services

professionalSummary.text: Prepared and quality-checked change requests for eleven fortnightly releases of a consumer banking app, ensuring rollback plans, test evidence, and named ownership were included before submission to the change advisory board.

professionalSummary.text: Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and maintained the release calendar, publishing outcomes to engineering squads after the board chair made the go/no-go decision.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated pre-release activities with four app engineering squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved issues to the operations manager 48 hours before release freeze.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-freeze checklist with the four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved ones to the operations manager two days before each freeze.

professionalSummary.text: Authored post-release summaries for each cycle, documenting incidents, rollbacks, and open items carried into the next cycle for review by the operations manager.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the post-release summary for each cycle, listing incidents, any rollback and the open items carried into the next cycle, which the operations manager reviewed.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release cycle as part of the change management process.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included change-request preparation, board record keeping, pre-freeze coordination and post-release reporting for the mobile release train over about a year.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed the full change management lifecycle for eleven fortnightly releases of a consumer banking app, including preparation, quality-checking, and post-release reporting.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included change-request preparation, board record keeping, pre-freeze coordination and post-release reporting for the mobile release train over about a year.

skills.text: Change management, release coordination, cross-functional communication, documentation, and reporting for mobile app services.

Wrote the post-release summary for each cycle, listing incidents, any rollback and the open items carried into the next cycle, which the operations manager reviewed.
Responsibilities included change-request preparation, board record keeping, pre-freeze coordination and post-release reporting for the mobile release train over about a year.
